description: The countries of the UBL example world, with their currencies, tax schemes and identifier and address schemes. XU, XB and XL are ISO 3166-1 user-assigned codes; tools/build_codelists.py adds them and the world currencies to copies of the UBL 2.5 default code lists (world/codelists). Tax scheme identifiers are UN/EDIFACT 5153 codes (VAT, STT state/provincial sales tax, CUD customs duty, IMP import tax).

XU.name: Urvania
XU.note: Mainland, inland. Raw materials and manufacturing.

currency.name: Ferra
currency.note: ISO 4217 style: the country code and the initial of the currency's name; checked against the current ISO 4217 list. No minor unit: amounts are whole ferra, as with the Japanese yen.

tax.summary: Value added tax in the style of the EU VAT: charged at every stage, deducted by businesses, not charged on exports.

schemes.name: Value added tax
schemes.exports: not charged; the export is shown with its exemption reason

schemes.name: Energy tax
schemes.levied_on: electricity, per kWh delivered in the month
schemes.note: An excise in ferra per kWh, lower above 50,000 kWh a month for industry; value added tax is charged on the price plus the energy tax.

tax.exemption_codes_note: The exemption reasons as codes of Urvania's national list (world/codelists/lists.json, XU:TaxExemptionReason); the EU's VATEX list does not apply in the world.

tax_id.format: XU and 9 digits, the last a check digit (weights 9..2, modulus 11)

address.line_rule: A line is made of the fields named in it, in that order, separated by a space; a field the address does not have is left out, and a line without any field is left out. A field with two language versions (street and town names in a bilingual country) gives both on the line, the national language first, then ' / ', then English: the building number is written once. Fields that are not on a line (ID, AddressTypeCode, CountrySubentityCode, TimezoneOffset, LocationCoordinate) say something other than where the post goes. The country is the last line of a postal address and is not repeated in the lines.

SUA.name: Società urvaniana per azioni (public limited company)

SRU.name: Società a responsabilità urvaniana (private limited company)

payment.terms: 30 days net; 2 % discount when paid within 10 days.

system.name: Ferra clearing of the central bank of Urvania

payment.note: Urvanian practice: a cash discount for early payment, statutory interest on late payment.

XU.history: An Italian territory, then under British rule, independent since 1962 as a bilingual country: Urvanian and English are its official languages. Its place and street names are the Italian ones the British kept, now part of English; Urvanian gives every place its own name too, and addresses carry both.

phone_plan.note: Open numbering, kept from Italian times: the area code starts with 0 and stays in the number, also from abroad; the longer the area code, the shorter the number: Ferrano 041 and 7 digits (10 in all), Serravona 0413 and 5 digits (9). Mobiles start with 3 and have 10 digits.

XU.legal_forms_note: The legal forms of Urvania as codes of its national list (world/codelists/lists.json, XU:CompanyLegalForm), with the abbreviation a company's registered name ends in.

tax.name: VAT number of Urvania
tax.format: XU and 9 digits, the last a check digit (weights 9..2, modulus 11)

property.name: property standard of the Codana Identification Agency
property.format: UR-, two letters for the part of the standard (SF street furniture, WD wood), four digits

vehicle-register.name: vehicle register of Urvania
vehicle-register.format: UR, the four-digit number of the registering district (4160 Ferrano) and two letters

aircraft-register.name: civil aircraft register of Urvania
aircraft-register.format: the nationality mark QU, a hyphen and three letters

rail-vehicle-register.name: national vehicle register of Urvania (railway vehicles)
rail-vehicle-register.format: the UIC 12-digit wagon number: interoperability and gauge (2 digits), country 46, type (4), serial (3) and the check digit

call-sign.name: radio call sign of an Urvanian ship
call-sign.format: the call sign series QU and up to four letters or digits

mmsi.name: MMSI of an Urvanian ship
mmsi.format: maritime identification digits 297 and six digits

address-register.name: national address register of Urvania
address-register.format: 16 digits: the four-digit code of the municipality, 20 for an address, and a ten-digit serial number

bank-branch.name: ABI and CAB code of an Urvanian bank branch
bank-branch.format: the five-digit ABI code of the bank and the five-digit CAB code of the branch, Italian style

haulage-licence.name: register of road haulage licences of Urvania
haulage-licence.format: XU-HAUL-, the year of issue and a four-digit number

waste-permit.name: register of waste treatment permits of Urvania
waste-permit.format: XU-ENV-, the year of issue and a four-digit number

XB.name: Bayvarra
XB.note: Mainland, coast. Distribution, retail, seaport and airport hub.

currency.name: Lume
currency.note: ISO 4217 style: the country code and the initial of the currency's name; checked against the current ISO 4217 list. Two decimals, the most common case.

tax.summary: A federal country: its states, and the federal territory in the north, levy a retail sales tax, charged once, on the sale to the final consumer. Sales to businesses that resell, exports and sales to public bodies are exempt, and the invoice says so.
tax.exemption_codes_note: The exemption reasons as codes of Bayvarra's national list (world/codelists/lists.json, XB:TaxExemptionReason); the EU's VATEX list does not apply in the world.

withholding.on: services by businesses not established in Bayvarra, paid by a public body
withholding.note: The public body withholds 10 % of the price and pays it to the state for the supplier; a non-resident supplier appoints a tax representative in Bayvarra.

tax_id.format: state code (UL Upland State, CO Coastal State, NT Northern Territory), hyphen, 7 digits (sales tax permit of the state or territory)

address.line_rule: A line is made of the fields named in it, in that order, separated by a space; a field the address does not have is left out, and a line without any field is left out. A field with two language versions (street and town names in a bilingual country) gives both on the line, the national language first, then ' / ', then English: the building number is written once. Fields that are not on a line (ID, AddressTypeCode, CountrySubentityCode, TimezoneOffset, LocationCoordinate) say something other than where the post goes. The country is the last line of a postal address and is not repeated in the lines.

subdivision_rule.note: Bayvarran land north of map row 15 (row < 15) is the Northern Territory, a federal territory on the thinly populated north coast with Gullhaven, the gas plant and, offshore, the gas field. South of it the state border runs north-south at map column 29: the border region and the distributor are in Upland State (column < 29), Lumeport and the coast in Coastal State.

payment.terms: 30 days net; 1.5 % surcharge per month late.

system.name: Lumeport interbank payments
system.clearing_channels_note: Lumepay settles batches in a mass payment net system (MPNS) and instant payments in real time on a net basis (RTNS).

payment.note: Bayvarran practice: a surcharge per month of late payment, no discount.

cash_rounding.note: The smallest coin of the lume is 5 cents: a cash payment is rounded to 0.05; a card payment is not.

phone_plan.note: British-style closed numbering: always 10 digits after the country digit; the area code takes 2 to 5 of them (Lumeport 38, Upland State 7121, Gullhaven 38522 in the Northern Territory: the plan is national and does not follow state borders) and the trunk prefix 0 is dropped from abroad. Mobiles start with 7.

XB.legal_forms_note: The legal forms of Bayvarra as codes of its national list (world/codelists/lists.json, XB:CompanyLegalForm), with the abbreviation a company's registered name ends in.

tax.name: sales tax permit of a Bayvarran state or territory
tax.format: the state code (UL, CO, NT), a hyphen and 7 digits

vehicle-register.name: federal vehicle register of Bayvarra
vehicle-register.format: BV, two letters for the series and four digits

aircraft-register.name: civil aircraft register of Bayvarra
aircraft-register.format: the nationality mark QB, a hyphen and three letters

rail-vehicle-register.name: national vehicle register of Bayvarra (railway vehicles)
rail-vehicle-register.format: the UIC 12-digit wagon number with country 47

call-sign.name: radio call sign of a Bayvarran ship
call-sign.format: the call sign series QB and up to four letters or digits

mmsi.name: MMSI of a Bayvarran ship
mmsi.format: maritime identification digits 298 and six digits

lumeport:address-register.name: address register of the City of Lumeport
lumeport:address-register.format: LUM-ADR- and six digits; the city keeps its own register, which the state register of Coastal State refers to

bank-branch.name: sort code of a Bayvarran bank branch
bank-branch.format: six digits, British style; the first two name the bank

forestry-register.name: forestry register of Bayvarra
forestry-register.format: XB-FOR-REG- and the four-digit number of a registered forest owner or sawmill; XB-FOR-, the year and the same number for a certificate issued under that registration

bonded-warehouse.name: register of bonded warehouse licences of Bayvarra's customs

XL.name: Lisavu
XL.note: Island. The overseas buyer, reached by sea and air.

currency.name: Coral
currency.note: ISO 4217 style: the country code and the initial of the currency's name; checked against the current ISO 4217 list. Three decimals, as with the Bahraini or Kuwaiti dinar.

tax.summary: An island without a general sales tax or VAT: the state is financed by customs duty and an import consumption tax, both collected by customs at import. Domestic sales carry no tax, and the invoice says so.

withholding.on: the price of farm produce bought from farmers, by the buyer
withholding.note: A presumptive income tax: the buyer withholds 1 % of a delivery's value up to 2,000 coral and 2 % above, and pays it to the Island Customs Service, the island's only tax office.

tax_id.format: the companies register number; there is no separate tax number

address.line_rule: A line is made of the fields named in it, in that order, separated by a space; a field the address does not have is left out, and a line without any field is left out. A field with two language versions (street and town names in a bilingual country) gives both on the line, the national language first, then ' / ', then English: the building number is written once. Fields that are not on a line (ID, AddressTypeCode, CountrySubentityCode, TimezoneOffset, LocationCoordinate) say something other than where the post goes. The country is the last line of a postal address and is not repeated in the lines.

system.name: Coral net of the Bank of Selanu

ledger.note: Coral net settles tokenised coral deposits on the Bank of Selanu's permissioned ledger; an account on it names the ledger.

payment.note: Island practice: longer terms, simple interest on late payment.

cotton.note: The cotton fund of the Selanu Chamber of Commerce is financed by a levy of 1 % of the value of seed cotton sold, which the farm collects from the gin on the fund's behalf. Seed cotton is priced from the trade accord's lint reference price, published in lume by the Lumeport Trade Accord Council.

phone_plan.note: A small island: 7-digit numbers without area codes; fixed lines start with 72, mobiles with 77, ships with 79.

XL.legal_forms_note: The legal forms of Lisavu as codes of its national list (world/codelists/lists.json, XL:CompanyLegalForm), with the abbreviation a company's registered name ends in.

vehicle-register.name: vehicle register of Lisavu
vehicle-register.format: LV, the district or series letters and a number of up to four digits

aircraft-register.name: civil aircraft register of Lisavu
aircraft-register.format: the nationality mark QL, a hyphen and three letters

rail-vehicle-register.name: national vehicle register of Lisavu (railway vehicles)
rail-vehicle-register.format: the UIC 12-digit wagon number with country 48 (the island has no railway yet)

call-sign.name: radio call sign of a Lisavan ship
call-sign.format: the call sign series QL and up to four letters or digits

mmsi.name: MMSI of a Lisavan ship
mmsi.format: maritime identification digits 299 and six digits

delivery-point.name: delivery point number of the Lisavu Post Office
delivery-point.format: eight digits: the island has no postal codes, and the post office numbers every address it delivers to

bank-branch.name: branch number of a Lisavan bank

exchange_rates_note: Units of the second currency for one unit of the first, the reference rates of the world's frozen moment: 1 lume = 100 ferra, 1 lume = 0.4 coral.

geography.note: The world lies in an empty part of the South Atlantic, about 40° South and 15° West: every coordinate in the examples points to open sea on a real map. Map tile (i, j) lies at latitude 39.80 + 0.01·j degrees South and longitude 15.60 − 0.01·i degrees West.
geography.telephone_note: Telephone numbers use +999, a country code that the ITU reserves for a future global service (ITU-T E.164), so no number in the examples can reach anyone; the next digit is the world's country, and each country has its own numbering plan and number length (world/countries.json, phone_plan).

payment_cross_border.name: Payment link of the Lumeport Trade Accord
payment_cross_border.note: Payments between the three countries run over the trade accord's link; charges are shared (ISO 20022 SHAR).

qau.name: Urvanian
qau.note: The language of Urvania's original population, invented for the world, with a consonant-rich sound of its own (endings in -ek, -an, -ir). Urvania was an Italian territory and then under British rule; the British kept the Italian place and street names, while the people kept their Urvanian names for the same places. Since independence Urvania is bilingual, Urvanian and English, and the inherited Italian names count as English: they are never tagged as Italian. Code from the range ISO 639 reserves for local use (qaa–qtz); texts from a fixed invented vocabulary, word by word; the English text beside it is the reference.

qal.name: Lisavan
qal.note: The island's language, invented for the world, with a Polynesian sound like the island's names: syllables of a consonant and a vowel, no clusters, words ending in a vowel. It is official beside English. Code from the ISO 639 local-use range; texts from a fixed invented vocabulary, word by word; the English text beside it is the reference. Its words are checked so that none is a common word of a real Polynesian language.

en.name: English
en.note: Bayvarra's language, official on the island beside Lisavan, and the working language between the three countries.

urn:ubl-examples:world:endpoint.name: electronic address in the Trade Accord's exchange network
urn:ubl-examples:world:endpoint.format: the country code, a colon and the party's number in its country's companies register

urn:ubl-examples:world:account.name: account number in the structure of ISO 13616
urn:ubl-examples:world:account.format: in the structure of ISO 13616: the country code, two check digits (ISO 7064 mod 97-10) and the national account number, which holds the bank and branch codes: in Bayvarra the bank code, the six-digit sort code and 8 digits; in Urvania the ABI and CAB codes (5 + 5 digits) and 12 digits; on the island the bank code, the three-digit branch number and 10 digits

urn:ubl-examples:world:item.name: Codana item number
urn:ubl-examples:world:item.format: twelve digits issued by the Codana Identification Agency, Urvania's public numbering body: 771, 772 or 773 for the maker's country, eight digits and a check digit

urn:ubl-examples:world:vessel.name: national register of ships
urn:ubl-examples:world:vessel.format: the register's prefix and five digits

urn:ubl-examples:world:grid.name: grid reference of the world map

ISO 11649.name: ISO 11649 structured creditor reference
ISO 11649.format: RF, two check digits (ISO 7064 mod 97-10) and up to 21 letters and digits

ISO 6166.name: ISO 6166 International Securities Identification Number
ISO 6166.format: the issuer's country code, nine letters or digits, a check digit (Luhn)

ISO6346.name: ISO 6346 container number
ISO6346.format: owner code, U, six digits and the check digit

UN/LOCODE.name: UN/LOCODE location code
UN/LOCODE.format: the country code and three letters

GS1 GTIN.name: GS1 Global Trade Item Number
GS1 GTIN.format: GTIN-13: the company prefix (952, the prefix GS1 reserves for demonstrations and examples, and four digits), a five-digit item reference and the check digit

GS1 GLN.name: GS1 Global Location Number
GS1 GLN.format: the company prefix (952 and four digits), a five-digit location reference and the check digit

GS1 SSCC.name: GS1 Serial Shipping Container Code
GS1 SSCC.format: extension digit 0, the company prefix (952 and four digits), a nine-digit serial reference and the check digit

ISO 6523.name: ISO/IEC 6523 organisation identifier
ISO 6523.format: the international code designator 0990 of the Codana Identification Agency, a colon and the organisation's five-digit Codana company number

ISO 15459.name: ISO/IEC 15459 licence plate of a transport unit
ISO 15459.format: the issuing agency code KXU of the Codana Identification Agency, the five-digit company number, a nine-digit serial number and a check digit (mod 10 with weights 3 and 1 from the right); the data identifier J of the bar code is not part of it

urn:ubl-examples:world:bank-identifier.name: bank identifier code of the Trade Accord's payment link
urn:ubl-examples:world:bank-identifier.format: in the structure of ISO 9362 with the world's country codes: four letters for the bank, the country code, two characters for the location and an optional branch code

identifier_schemes_note: Identifiers from a scheme name it in schemeID (decisions ID-Q1 to ID-Q4). The Trade Accord's schemes and the real external ones are in identifier_schemes, by schemeID; each country's own are in its identifiers, by kind, with the schemeID urn:ubl-examples:world:<CC>:<kind>; a kind marked scheme false (call signs, MMSIs, driving licences, national ID numbers) has a format the world checks but no schemeID. The ITU call sign series and aircraft nationality marks QU, QB and QL, the MMSI maritime identification digits 297, 298 and 299 and the UIC country codes 46, 47 and 48 are not allocated to any real country (analysis/codelist-decisions.md, Fictional values). tools/world_ids.py checks them.
card_schemes_note: Card numbers follow ISO/IEC 7812: the major industry identifier 9 (national assignment) and the ISO 3166 numeric code of the issuer's country (901 Urvania, 902 Bayvarra, 903 Lisavu), then the issuer's two digits, the account and a Luhn check digit. A chip application identifier (ISO/IEC 7816-5) starts with the registered application provider identifier (RID) of the card scheme, from the national registration category D followed by the country code. A receipt shows the card number masked as the merchant's till does, at most the first six and the last four digits (PCI DSS), and never the security code or the card's dates.
